validity.researcher_notes: Reading the two Gazprom Transgaz Tomsk corporate-newspaper PDFs (ttg_n121, Oct 2014) and dated news (energyland.info 2010; kuzbass.aif.ru 2025-10-11; kuzbass.media 2026-08-25) together surfaces a genuine, previously-unflagged staged-construction picture for this row's 'second line' (вторая нитка) duplication project: (1) energyland.info (2010-10-14) documents second-line reconstruction reaching km 404 (within Yurga LPUMG territory) as an in-progress project at that time; (2) ttg_n121 (Oct 2014) states 'V Yurginskom filiale dva goda nazad byla postroena i zapushchena v ekspluatatsiyu vtoraya nitka MG Parabel-Kuzbass' (in the Yurga branch, two years ago [~2012] the second line was built and commissioned) -- this appears to be the direct source of the sheet's StartYear1=2012, but describes ONLY the Yurga-territory completion, not the whole 714km segment; the SAME Oct-2014 article separately describes the Novokuznetsk-territory second-line construction as just beginning, targeting completion around 2017; (3) kuzbass.aif.ru (2025-10-11, verified): Kuzbass governor Ilya Seredyuk, at a federal Siberian-district gasification meeting, 'podcherknul vazhnost uskoreniya stroitelstva vtoroy nitki magistralnogo gazoprovoda «Parabel-Kuzbass» v Novokuznetske' (emphasized the importance of speeding up construction of the second line of the Parabel-Kuzbass trunk pipeline IN NOVOKUZNETSK) and states the completion target was JUST moved from 2029 to 2027 -- i.e. as of Oct 2025, more than a decade after the 2014 article's ~2017 target, the Novokuznetsk portion of the second line is STILL not complete. (4) kuzbass.media (2026-08-25, verified) confirms the underlying single-line trunk itself is actively operating/maintained (a planned week-long maintenance outage on 'MG Parabel-Kuzbass' near Novokuznetsk). Net read: the BASE single-line pipeline along this 714km corridor is real, operating, and not in dispute (see the Length fill and the status_review on this shard, both confirm). What is in genuine question is whether 'segment II' as GEM records it -- one row, StartYear1=2012, implicitly representing a complete duplicated (double) line -- accurately reflects a build that was staged over at least three separate LPUMG territories/years (Yurga ~2012; Kemerovo territory, possibly never duplicated, relying on cross-tie redundancy per reph.ru 2015; Novokuznetsk 2014-2027+, still incomplete). Flagging for human review rather than proposing a specific edit, since GEM's own convention for how 'segment II' should be modeled (one row per eventual double-line corridor vs. per completed duplication stage) is a judgment call outside this researcher's authority to resolve. A secondary observation not proposed as a contested value: the reph.ru 2015 Kemerovo detail is read from context in an already-open document and was not independently re-verified as its own citation this pass -- flagged with appropriately lower confidence than the Oct-2014/Oct-2025 dated items, which are directly and explicitly on point. | contested (as authored): {"StartYear1": "2012 (recorded) appears to reflect only the Yurga-territory portion of this 714km segment's second-line duplication. The Novokuznetsk-territory portion (roughly the km 572-714 stretch) began second-line construction in Oct 2014 and, per a dated Oct-2025 statement by the Kuzbass governor, is STILL under construction, with the completion target just moved from 2029 to 2027 -- so treating the whole 714km segment as uniformly complete/operating since 2012 overstates its status.", "LengthKnown": "714.00 km may overstate the segment's continuous DOUBLE-line extent specifically. A 2015 reph.ru article describing Kemerovo-territory gas dispatch strategy suggests that stretch (roughly km 404-572) relies on cross-tie redundancy with the separate Novosibirsk-Kuzbass trunk rather than its own second line -- if so, the physically continuous double-line loop covered by this row may not span the full 714km uninterrupted. This does not contest the single-line base pipeline's 714km length (which the Length fill on this shard supports), only whether 'segment II' as GEM records it represents one continuous, currently-complete duplicated line."}
